axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.rationale: The complete proposal addresses the named workflows and hard negatives; policy values remain explicit decisions.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.rationale: Governing facts/conditions are supported in the finite domains reviewed.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.rationale: Four useful architecture alternatives and directly applicable CouchDB attachment repair/code/test/release evidence are retained.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.rationale: All exact plan clauses and both critic findings have defensible dispositions; the rejected CI-count criticism is independently disproved.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.rationale: Core workflows, constraints, conditional mechanisms and owner decisions survive; complete predecessor source records are preserved without rebinding.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.rationale: Failure scenarios have observable desired outcomes and are consistently proposed; no product test/deployment is asserted as executed.

critic_dispositions.note: Unreviewed free text is excluded; uncertain screening omits text and raw snippets are not returned.
Historical merge record and current Checks tab are different observations; no local test execution is claimed.

preservation.record_integrity: All 38 inherited control source records equal predecessors.
preservation.semantic_review: Independently traced workflows, hard negatives, current authorization, duplicate/backup cases, alternative tradeoffs, photo/cache/backup limitations, open decisions and proposed validation. Record equality was corroboration, not semantic proof.

excluded_or_unassessed.reason: Proposal deliverable; no execution required or performed.

finite_scope: COMPLETE means each required obligation/axis was assessed in the declared material domain, not every upstream file, all product mechanisms, or universal correctness. Supplemental failed current-core locators are explicit and do not certify that separate domain.
